For better or worse, this place was already a dump before the riot, so no one bothered to set it on fire.
Ugh.
Now I just realised that I don’t even know his name…
I would call out for him, if I knew it. I can’t really shout ‘Hobo! Where are you?’ and expect him to come…
Either way, he doesn’t appear to be here. 
I have no other choice. I need to go further, to even more dangerous parts of the city…
